context: The party has stepped into the inner sanctum of a long-abandoned chapel — a once-holy place now thick with dust and silence. Shadowheart (and in some variations a mystic) is present and puzzlingly unable to identify which god the chapel served; whatever power lingered here is muted or unfamiliar. The group may have already tried prayers, divination, or to open a magically sealed chest, with mixed or null results depending on who attempts them. The player’s line is a quiet, reverential reflection on the emptiness and loss that fills the room.
